In its first hour it did about $357k of volume against a ~$165k market cap and rose about 220%. GeckoTerminal counts 933 unique buyers against 176 unique sellers. It has no website, no socials, no DexScreener profile and no description. GMGN tags 151 bundler wallets. RugCheck shows one unlabeled wallet holding 80.05% of supply and 99.99% of LP unlocked. The creator has already closed out (creator_close) and has 2 earlier launches, the best of which peaked at about $455k market cap. I found no narrative anywhere on the web.
